hooks.command: jq -e '.tool_input.command // "" | test("bun +(run +)?(\\./)?src/build\\.ts") and (test("--out") | not)' >/dev/null && { echo 'A bare bun src/build.ts replaces dist/. Add --out "$(mktemp -d)".' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

jq -e --arg root "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/" '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // "" | ltrimstr($root) | startswith("dist/")' >/dev/null && { echo 'dist/ is build output. Change the sources instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0
